Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('share/res/gpac_cfg_test.mp4')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# brute-force a few candidate mutations around moov/trak/stbl boundaries and keep the best by submit output
cands=[]
for start,end,x in [(28,600,0xFF),(200,1200,0x01),(300,1800,0x5A),(len(data)-2000,len(data)-100,0xFF)]:
    d=bytearray(data)
    for off in range(start,end): d[off]^=x
    cands.append(d)
for i,d in enumerate(cands):
    Path(f'/workspace/cand{i}.mp4').write_bytes(d)
print('done',len(cands))
PY
